scope: Frozen native-candidate ablation; separate database API microbenchmarks. Not a live ELF replacement or complete agent benchmark.
scale_generator: Seeded mixture of cached real vectors with Gaussian noise; synthetic geometry, not a large real corpus.
hybrid: Separate native lexical and dense queries, common client RRF(k=60), top 10. PostgreSQL uses built-in simple FTS rather than a BM25 extension.
sustained_followup: Three ten-second rounds, eight independent clients, warm repeated 70-query set, 49,999 vectors after matched deletion. Initial 280-query bursts retained but not used as sustained throughput.
post_followup_source_changes: Dependency lock capture, explicit client close, per-round failure retention, CLI argument checks and DuckDB answer aggregates; no product changes.
